name: Jia Wei
psychographics: Skeptical of corporate data motives; prefers human connection over algorithmic curation.
current_solutions: Uses a basic flip phone for calls and texts; pays for everything in cash at local markets; refuses to install WeChat for ride-hailing.
frustration: Arrived at the bakery at 9:15am to buy a bun; the cashier refused cash and demanded a QR code scan via a app she doesn't have, making her leave empty-handed and walk to a different shop two streets over.
decision_style: visits the shop in person, checks the price tag, and pays with notes if the vendor accepts it; otherwise she leaves.
voice: Concise and measured; switches between Mandarin and English mid-sentence when frustrated; uses minimal tech jargon.
